- Preferred: Private (customer VPC) deployment inside our AWS account; Dedicated reserved capacity in Redwood’s managed environment may be acceptable if the BAA explicitly prohibits Redwood personnel access to PHI and there is clear network isolation. Hi all — thanks for the context. Short answers up front, followed by specifics and next steps.

Short answers:
- BAA: Redwood provides a standard BAA and we can circulate a draft within 48 business hours. Legal turnaround on execution typically aligns with your 2–4 week expectation.
- SOC 2: Redwood holds SOC 2 Type II (security) with last assessment completed Nov 2026. I attached a one-page redacted summary (SOC2-summary.pdf).
- Eligible deployment modes for PHI:
  * Private (customer VPC / private deployment): YES — supported and preferred for PHI. Customer controls network and KMS; Redwood control plane access is restricted per deployment agreement.
  * Dedicated (reserved capacity in Redwood's environment): CONDITIONAL — allowed if the executed BAA includes explicit restrictions on Redwood personnel access to PHI and we configure dedicated tenant isolation + customer-managed encryption keys.
  * Hosted public API (shared multi-tenant endpoint): NO — we do not permit PHI ingestion via public hosted endpoints.

Technical boundary notes (short):
- PHI must never be stored unencrypted at rest in shared storage. For private deployments we can integrate with your KMS so Redwood never has plaintext key access.
- K/V cache and ephemeral token caches are cleared on session end; for PHI workloads we recommend session-scoped KV cache disabled unless explicitly approved.
- Audit logging: we can provide request-level audit logs (redacted request IDs) and operator access logs; retention and export options can be configured per contract.

Attachments provided: SOC2-summary.pdf (redacted) and a checklist we will use to answer your vendor questionnaire.

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben/Neha: send the questionnaire to us as a fillable PDF if possible; we'll assign owners and return a draft response in 3 business days.
2) Ben: share a draft BAA with Ellen — I will review and flag any items that need redlines from our security/legal side.
3) Schedule the technical session (30–45m) to walk deployment wiring and KMS integration. I have availability Wed Mar 24 (10:00–11:30 PT) and Thu Mar 25 (13:00–15:00 PT).

If helpful, we can also produce a short runbook describing how PHI flows through the private deployment and the controls at each step.

Thanks — Mina Haddad
